title: Update a contact's details, notes and custom fields
blurb: Open a customer's record to edit info, fill custom fields and add notes.

steps.title: Open the contact
steps.body: Search for the person and click their name.

steps.title: Edit their details
steps.body: The left panel holds their contact info, **Tags**, **DND** settings and your custom field folders. Click a field to edit. It saves as soon as you click away.

steps.title: Fill in custom fields
steps.body: Open a custom field folder, like Job Details, and fill in the fields. Need a new field? See **Create a custom field** in the Guide.

steps.title: Add a note
steps.body: In the right panel, open **Notes** and add a note, such as what you discussed on the phone.

steps.title: See the full history
steps.body: The middle shows every message, call, appointment and change for this person, newest at the bottom.
